I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer for this small rented plot, and beans grow well enough with the manure I can collect from our animals. I will plant the same local bean seeds I have saved from last season because they are free and I know they do well here. With only a quarter hectare, my family and I can manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without paying for workers.
